messages:
morgan: Heads-up — planning a mixed-traffic soak this weekend (k6 replay + Locust burst overlay). Need volunteers for: flamegraph capture, kernel perf, and verifying KV cache warmup. Window: Sat 02:00-06:00 UTC.

anya: I can own the Locust overlay. Do we have the user journey CSV and the burst script?

morgan: @anya linked the replay bucket in the runbook: s3://rw-soak/replays/2026-03-golden.csv. Burst overlay will be a separate locustfile that spikes new sessions at T+10m.

raj: For the k6 part, are we still using the v2 replay harness that preserves headers and cookies? want to ensure auth paths hit the same shard.

morgan: yes -- use the k6-replay binary from infra-tools:v1.4. Command: 
```
./k6-replay --input s3://rw-soak/replays/2026-03-golden.csv --rate-schedule "ramp-up 0 1000 300s, hold 1000 10800s" --preserve-headers
```
This will run the steady replay. Locust will add periodic 10k rps bursts as a separate load generator.

kim: Quick ask on observability: can we capture per-model p50/p95/p99 and KV cache hit ratio, plus GPU utilization traces? Also let's capture heap and thread stacks every 30s for any tail latency spikes.

oliver: I'll wire up the perf agents. Plan: 
- perf-agent on model hosts -> linux perf + eBPF stack counts
- jmap/jstack for JVM services (if any)
- node-exporter + custom kv cache exporter (delta counters)
I'll push a small daemonset and share runbook.

anya: Locust config snippet (will run from locust-prod-2):
```python
from locust import HttpUser, task, between
class BurstUser(HttpUser):
  wait_time = between(1, 3)
  @task
  def journey(self):
    self.client.get('/api/v1/ingest', headers={'x-replay-id': '2026-03'})
```
I'll also attach a CSV mapping for session IDs.

raj: Important: we should pin model variants to avoid rollouts during the soak. Can infra set routing to stable:sha=2026-03-08? Otherwise we might get noise from canary.

morgan: Good call. @soak-scheduler can you lock model routing and DB failover?

soak-scheduler: Locking routing now: pinned to stable:sha=2026-03-08 across region-us, region-eu. DB failover disabled for window 1975309200-1975320000. Will annotate run in the incident log.

perf-bot: nightly-soak summary (from last dry run): tokens/sec 48k, p99 420ms, kv_hit 0.73, gpu_avg 64%. Attached flamegraphs in /artifacts/soak/2026-03-dryrun/.

kim: Can someone run a short smoke with 10% of the load today so we catch any config errors? I can do it midday.

anya: I'll run the smoke at 15:30 UTC. Will post a short checklist when starting.

morgan: checklist for the run (small):
- pin routing (done)
- warm KV cache: run 30m prefix-warm job
- start perf-agent with sampling=99Hz
- start k6-replay steady + locust overlay disabled
- validate p95 < 250ms for core endpoints

oliver: KV warm script: 
```bash
./prefix-warm --prefix /api/cache/ --workers 8 --duration 1800 --rate 5000/s
```
Will kick it 45m before soak window.

raj: For regression detection: let's push an eval set for the primary prompt bundles and run the model-eval job every 15m during soak. If any quality regression >3% drift, auto-notify #eng-runtime.

morgan: +1. Add a tie-in to alerting and create a temp runbook snippet for rollback (model fallback to quantized variant).

anya: Starting smoke in 10. Test report will be a one-line status + artifact link.

perf-bot: smoke started by @anya at 1975320000 (simulated). p95 initial 180ms, kv_hit 0.76. Uploading logs to /artifacts/soak/smoke-1975320000/

morgan: :thumbsup: good. Leave this thread open for any pre-run issues. If anyone finds a blocker, ping with "soak-blocker" tag.

oliver: I uploaded the perf-agent manifest to infra repo and left instructions under /docs/soak/runbook.md. Will be available to ops for roll-forward.

raj: One more ask — can we capture a short raw KV snapshot (keys only, sampled) pre/post soak to measure churn? small exporter script attached in runbook.

morgan: thanks all. Will post final window confirmation 1h before start.

anya: ack, will stand by.

soak-scheduler: Scheduled: 2026-03-14 02:00-06:00 UTC (window id soak-2026-03-14-02). Notifications sent to oncall.

morgan: Closing the loop: final prep call tomorrow 09:00 UTC (15m). Optional but helpful.

anya: attending.

kim: attending.

oliver: attending.

morgan: thanks everyone — let's catch regressions early and keep the run fast and observable.
